description: Chemist - Retail Pharmacy is responsible for supporting pharmacy operations by ensuring valid prescription processing, accurate order fulfilment, and effective customer interaction in compliance with regulatory standards. The role involves managing sales transactions, maintaining proper drug storage with cold chain and expiry monitoring, and handling inventory efficiently. The job holder is also expected to uphold the pharmacy 's professional image, promote responsible use of medicines, and contribute to pharmacovigilance and safe handling of controlled substances, while understanding the basics of retail operations within the Life Sciences industry.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to life Sciences Sector and basics of Retail Pharmacy
Perform Inventory Management and Replenishment in a Retail Pharmacy
Maintain Regulatory-Compliant Drug Storage Through Systematic Layout Planning, Expiry Management, and Cold Chain Monitoring
Ensure valid prescription processing, customer need assessment, and accurate order fulfilment as per Regulatory Standards
Processing the sales transactions in cash or credit at point of sale
Perform Pharmacovigilance, Promote Responsible Antibiotic Use, and Ensure Safe Handling of Controlled Substances
Comply EHS Rules and Sanitization Protocol at Retail Pharmacy in Compliance with Good Storage Area Practices

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PURSUINGSPECIALIZATION: Diploma in Pharmacy * Post approval from Pharmacy Council of India
